native_context: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy selection and enforced connectivity
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy selection and enforced connectivity — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Collect selected pod labels/namespaces, all applicable policies, CNI/enforcement capability and actual source-to-destination network path. Include DNS/egress requirements where relevant.
controls.controlled_verification: Resolve one prohibited ingress/egress tuple and one required service path using policy composition and an owned isolated reachability check where available. Check which pods each selector actually selects; a policy file with no matching pods is not evidence of protection.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: NetworkPolicies compose allow behavior; a restrictive-looking policy may coexist with another allowance. Host networking, service translation and CNI details can affect the claimed result.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Correct the evidenced selectors/ports/peers under the real CNI contract. Retest the prohibited tuple, required service/DNS path and unchanged application availability.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
